CONSOLIDATED 2026-10-24 into rel-audit. All M6 acceptance criteria, prerequisite edges, representative workload, numerical/consumer/persistence checks and policy requirements are preserved in the consolidated pre-publication audit. This is an alias consolidation, not a declaration that M6 acceptance passed.

Historical scope (retained for reference):
M6 of docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md. Completion requires baseline workflow coverage, task-first executable documentation, typed plan/codec persistence with exact artifact identity and stated numerical contracts, downstream extension proof, and existing scientific/build/release gates. Recheck current CI evidence instead of inheriting old counts. Capture a representative recording workload and practical time/memory limits without speculative optimization. The separate UI application, licensed EDF programme, and new vendor formats are not prerequisites for this foundation milestone. Existing real ASC support requirements remain in force for release claims.
